```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
  library(nflplotR)
  library(magick)
})
PROJECT_DIR <- "c:/Users/kailo/kayceeslices/NFL Analytics"
setwd(PROJECT_DIR)
source("config.R")
source("logging_utils.R")
source("tools/elo_model.R")

division_colors <- c(
  "AFC East" = "#0D3B5C", "AFC North" = "#115677", "AFC South" = "#15708D", "AFC West" = "#198595",
  "NFC East" = "#219A9B", "NFC North" = "#2CB0A1", "NFC South" = "#3CC1A7", "NFC West" = "#4FD1AE"
)

bg_dark     <- "#1e2228"
panel_dark  <- "#262b33"
grid_dark   <- "#3a4049"
text_light  <- "#d8dee5"

theme_elo_dark <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = bg_dark, color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = panel_dark, color = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = bg_dark, color = NA),
      legend.key        = element_rect(fill = panel_dark, color = NA),
      strip.background  = element_rect(fill = panel_dark, color = NA),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = grid_dark),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      text              = element_text(color = text_light),
      axis.text         = element_text(color = text_light),
      strip.text        = element_text(color = text_light, face = "bold"),
      plot.title        = element_text(color = text_light)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-elo
sch <- readRDS(CACHE_SCHEDULES)
fatigue <- if (file.exists(CACHE_FATIGUE_METRICS)) {
  readRDS(CACHE_FATIGUE_METRICS)
} else {
  data.frame(game_id = character(0), team = character(0), fatigue_drag_pts = numeric(0))
}

elo_hist <- sch |>
  filter(!is.na(home_score), !is.na(away_score),
         season >= MODERN_ERA_START_SEASON, season <= CURRENT_SEASON) |>
  mutate(gameday = as.Date(gameday))

elo_run <- run_elo_walkforward(elo_hist, fatigue, ELO_K_FACTOR, return_final_state = TRUE)
elo_games <- elo_run$games

# Current rating per team: each team's final walkforward rating, carryover-projected to
# CURRENT_SEASON (same logic team_ratings_engine.R's live ensemble uses via project_elo_rating()).
current_ratings <- tibble(
  team = names(elo_run$final_elo),
  final_elo = unname(elo_run$final_elo),
  last_season = unname(elo_run$final_season)
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(current_elo = project_elo_rating(final_elo, last_season, CURRENT_SEASON)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(division = NFL_DIVISIONS[team],
         conference = substr(division, 1, 3)) |>
  filter(!is.na(division))

# Regular-season games played so far this season, both team perspectives, with PRE-GAME
# (no-hindsight) Elo for both the team and its opponent.
reg_current <- elo_games |>
  filter(season == CURRENT_SEASON) |>
  inner_join(sch |> select(game_id, game_type), by = "game_id") |>
  filter(game_type == "REG")

long_games <- bind_rows(
  reg_current |> transmute(game_id, week, team = home_team, opp = away_team,
                            team_elo_pre = home_elo_pre, opp_elo_pre = away_elo_pre,
                            team_win = home_win, team_win_prob = elo_prob_pure),
  reg_current |> transmute(game_id, week, team = away_team, opp = home_team,
                            team_elo_pre = away_elo_pre, opp_elo_pre = home_elo_pre,
                            team_win = 1L - home_win, team_win_prob = 1 - elo_prob_pure)
)

team_performance <- long_games |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(games_played = n(),
            wins = sum(team_win),
            win_pct = mean(team_win),
            expected_win_pct = mean(team_win_prob),
            avg_opponent_elo = mean(opp_elo_pre),
            surprise_index = win_pct - expected_win_pct,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(current_ratings |> select(team, current_elo), by = "team") |>
  mutate(division = NFL_DIVISIONS[team], conference = substr(division, 1, 3))
```

## Current Elo Rating by Team

Live Elo state after every game played through Week 5, carryover-projected to the current
season (`ELO_SEASON_CARRYOVER` applied only to teams that haven't yet played this season — not
relevant by Week 5). Dashed line marks `ELO_INITIAL_RATING` (1500), an average team.

```{r}
#| label: fig-current-elo
#| fig-cap: "Current Elo rating, by division, Week 5 2026"
p_current <- ggplot(current_ratings, aes(x = reorder(team, current_elo), y = current_elo, fill = division)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_nfl_logos(aes(team_abbr = team), width = 0.04, y = 60) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~conference, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = division_colors) +
  theme_elo_dark() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "elo_current_rating.png"), p_current, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 150, bg = bg_dark)
p_current
```

## Week-to-Week Elo Trajectory

Each team's **pre-game** Elo rating entering every week it played this season, plus its current
(post-Week-5) rating as the final point — so each line traces exactly what the team's rating was
at kickoff each week, never a look-ahead value. Bye weeks simply leave a gap in that team's line.
Faceted by division (same grouping/coloring as the figures above), one line per team within each
panel.

```{r}
#| label: fig-trajectory
#| fig-cap: "Week-to-week Elo trajectory, by division, through Week 5 2026"
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 9
trajectory <- bind_rows(
  long_games |> transmute(team, week, elo = team_elo_pre),
  current_ratings |> transmute(team, week = max(long_games$week) + 1L, elo = current_elo)
) |>
  distinct(team, week, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(division = NFL_DIVISIONS[team]) |>
  filter(!is.na(division))

p_trajectory <- ggplot(trajectory, aes(x = week, y = elo, group = team)) +
  geom_line(color = "#3CC1A7", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_nfl_logos(aes(team_abbr = team), width = 0.045) +
  facet_wrap(~division, ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(trajectory$week))) +
  theme_elo_dark() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Week (pre-game rating; last point = current)")

ggsave(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "elo_trajectory.png"), p_trajectory, width = 13, height = 9, dpi = 150, bg = bg_dark)
p_trajectory
```

## Average Opponent Elo Rating (Strength of Schedule)

For each team, the average Elo rating its opponents held **immediately before** that game was
played (no hindsight — an opponent that has since improved or collapsed doesn't retroactively
change how hard this team's schedule looked at kickoff). Regular season only, 2026.

```{r}
#| label: fig-sos
#| fig-cap: "Average opponent Elo (pre-game), by division, Week 5 2026"
p_sos <- ggplot(team_performance, aes(x = reorder(team, avg_opponent_elo), y = avg_opponent_elo, fill = division)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_nfl_logos(aes(team_abbr = team), width = 0.04, y = 60) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~conference, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = division_colors) +
  theme_elo_dark() +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "elo_avg_opponent.png"), p_sos, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 150, bg = bg_dark)
p_sos
```

### Team Elo vs. Schedule Strength

Own current Elo rating (x-axis) against average pre-game opponent Elo faced so far (y-axis).
Dashed lines mark the 1500 baseline on both axes — upper-right is "good team, hard schedule",
lower-left is "bad team, soft schedule".

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Team strength vs. strength of schedule, Week 5 2026"
p_scatter <- ggplot(team_performance, aes(x = current_elo, y = avg_opponent_elo)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_nfl_logos(aes(team_abbr = team), width = 0.045) +
  theme_elo_dark() +
  labs(x = "Current Elo rating", y = "Average opponent Elo (pre-game)")

ggsave(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "elo_sos_scatter.png"), p_scatter, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 150, bg = bg_dark)
p_scatter
```

### Animated: Team Strength vs. Schedule Strength, Week by Week

The same scatter plot as a weekly animation — each frame is the cumulative state through that
week (current Elo on the x-axis, average pre-game opponent Elo faced so far on the y-axis).
Each team's own history up to that frame is drawn as a faint grey trail behind its logo, fading
out the further back in the season a point is (piecewise-linear between the real weekly
positions, not a global spline — a cubic fit through only 2-5 noisy points overshoots badly and
produces loops that don't reflect the real path).

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-animated
#| fig-cap: "Animated: team strength vs. schedule strength, by week"
all_teams <- sort(unique(current_ratings$team))
max_week  <- max(long_games$week)

grid_tw <- expand_grid(team = all_teams, week = 1:(max_week + 1L))
traj_filled <- grid_tw |>
  left_join(trajectory |> select(team, week, elo), by = c("team", "week")) |>
  arrange(team, week) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  tidyr::fill(elo, .direction = "down") |>
  ungroup()

week_seq <- 1:max_week
snap_all <- bind_rows(lapply(week_seq, function(w) {
  y_df <- long_games |> filter(week <= w) |> group_by(team) |>
    summarise(avg_opponent_elo = mean(opp_elo_pre), .groups = "drop")
  x_df <- traj_filled |> filter(week == w + 1L) |> select(team, current_elo = elo)
  inner_join(x_df, y_df, by = "team") |> mutate(frame_week = w)
}))

xr <- range(snap_all$current_elo, na.rm = TRUE); yr <- range(snap_all$avg_opponent_elo, na.rm = TRUE)
pad_x <- diff(xr) * 0.1; pad_y <- diff(yr) * 0.1
anim_xlim <- xr + c(-pad_x, pad_x); anim_ylim <- yr + c(-pad_y, pad_y)

frame_dir <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "elo_anim_frames")
if (!dir.exists(frame_dir)) dir.create(frame_dir)
frame_files <- character(0)

for (w in week_seq) {
  trail_segs <- bind_rows(lapply(all_teams, function(tm) {
    hist_pts <- snap_all |> filter(team == tm, frame_week <= w) |> arrange(frame_week)
    if (nrow(hist_pts) < 2) return(NULL)
    n_interp <- 12 * (nrow(hist_pts) - 1) + 1
    sx_y <- approx(hist_pts$frame_week, hist_pts$current_elo, n = n_interp)$y
    sy_y <- approx(hist_pts$frame_week, hist_pts$avg_opponent_elo, n = n_interp)$y
    n <- length(sx_y)
    tibble(team = tm, x0 = sx_y[-n], y0 = sy_y[-n], x1 = sx_y[-1], y1 = sy_y[-1],
           recency = seq(0, 1, length.out = n - 1))
  }))
  if (nrow(trail_segs) == 0) {
    trail_segs <- tibble(team = character(0), x0 = numeric(0), y0 = numeric(0),
                          x1 = numeric(0), y1 = numeric(0), recency = numeric(0))
  }
  trail_segs <- trail_segs |> mutate(alpha_val = recency^1.6)

  cur <- snap_all |> filter(frame_week == w)

  p_frame <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = trail_segs, aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, alpha = alpha_val),
                 color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.02, 0.4), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ELO_INITIAL_RATING, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_nfl_logos(data = cur, aes(x = current_elo, y = avg_opponent_elo, team_abbr = team), width = 0.05) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = anim_xlim, ylim = anim_ylim) +
    theme_elo_dark() +
    labs(x = "Elo rating (cumulative)", y = "Avg. opponent Elo (pre-game, cumulative)",
         title = sprintf("Through Week %d, %d", w, CURRENT_SEASON))

  fpath <- file.path(frame_dir, sprintf("frame_%02d.png", w))
  ggsave(fpath, p_frame, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 120, bg = bg_dark)
  frame_files <- c(frame_files, fpath)
}

# Hold on the final (current) frame a few extra ticks so the GIF doesn't loop too fast.
frame_files_final <- c(frame_files, rep(tail(frame_files, 1), 4))
gif <- magick::image_animate(magick::image_join(magick::image_read(frame_files_final)), fps = 1, loop = 0)
gif_path <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "elo_scatter_animation.gif")
magick::image_write(gif, gif_path)

knitr::include_graphics(gif_path)
```

## Early-Season Upsets

A game counts as an upset if the team that won had a pre-game Elo win probability below 50%
(i.e. was the underdog once home-field advantage is baked in). Sorted by magnitude — how big a
longshot the winner was.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-upsets
upsets <- long_games |>
  filter(team_win == 1, team_win_prob < 0.5) |>
  transmute(week, underdog = team, favorite = opp,
            underdog_win_prob = round(team_win_prob, 3),
            underdog_elo = round(team_elo_pre, 0),
            favorite_elo = round(opp_elo_pre, 0),
            upset_magnitude = round(0.5 - team_win_prob, 3)) |>
  arrange(desc(upset_magnitude))

kable(upsets)
```

## Overperforming / Underperforming Against Schedule

`surprise_index` = actual win% minus Elo-implied expected win% (the average pre-game win
probability across that team's own games) — positive means winning more than the schedule/Elo
said it should, negative means losing more than expected.

### Good record despite a hard schedule

Teams facing a tougher-than-average slate (`avg_opponent_elo` above 1500) who are also
outperforming their Elo-implied expectation.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overperform-hard
team_performance |>
  filter(avg_opponent_elo > ELO_INITIAL_RATING) |>
  arrange(desc(surprise_index)) |>
  transmute(team, games_played, wins, win_pct = round(win_pct, 3),
            expected_win_pct = round(expected_win_pct, 3),
            avg_opponent_elo = round(avg_opponent_elo, 0),
            surprise_index = round(surprise_index, 3)) |>
  head(8) |>
  kable()
```

### Poor record despite a soft schedule

Teams facing an easier-than-average slate (`avg_opponent_elo` below 1500) who are also
underperforming their Elo-implied expectation.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-underperform-soft
team_performance |>
  filter(avg_opponent_elo < ELO_INITIAL_RATING) |>
  arrange(surprise_index) |>
  transmute(team, games_played, wins, win_pct = round(win_pct, 3),
            expected_win_pct = round(expected_win_pct, 3),
            avg_opponent_elo = round(avg_opponent_elo, 0),
            surprise_index = round(surprise_index, 3)) |>
  head(8) |>
  kable()
```

## Further Questions Worth Gathering

Candidates for follow-up analysis, not yet computed here:

- **Week-to-week Elo volatility** — which teams' ratings have swung the most since Week 1
  (biggest single-game Elo shift), as a proxy for "boom/bust" rather than steady teams.
- **Model vs. market disagreement** — compare this Elo-implied line against real market odds
  (`market_odds_engine.R`'s devigged probabilities) to flag games where the model and the market
  see a team very differently.
- **Division-race tightness** — current Elo gap between the top two teams in each division, to
  flag which races are closest heading into the back half of the season.
- **QB-injury-adjusted Elo swings** — cross-reference `qb_injury_features.R`'s QB-backup flags
  against this season's biggest Elo losses, to see how much of a team's slide is injury-driven
  vs. a genuine rating decline.
- **Pythagorean win% vs. Elo** — compare each team's point-differential-implied win% (already
  computed in `team_ratings_engine.R`) against its actual record, to separate "unlucky in close
  games" teams from teams whose Elo decline is about scoring, not variance.
- **Fatigue/rest correlation with upsets** — check whether this season's upsets (above) cluster
  on short-rest or high-travel games per `fatigue_engine.R`'s drag metric.
